_comment: Soul larva, fresh state. Per project_soul_larvae_cosmology: judged soul that just arrived at Acheron, imprint set but inward-firing has not yet built. Crawls from spawn anchor to shore, then stands at shore until enough wall-time passes for the inward-burn to hollow it out -- at which point the spawn-flow's on_arrival action swaps the archetype to larva_aged. Cosmologically the form closest to a freshly-deceased human walking. Visual differentiation from the Vagrant comes from texture (leached pale) and clip set (slow crawl) -- mesh + rig are shared per universal-humanoid-enemy-rule.
_comment_faction: Fresh larvae are NOT aggro-able. faction=Neutral gates the perception ladder at Unaware (tickPerception's faction check returns early). The applyArchetypeSwap to larva_aged later flips faction=Hostile via the new archetype's faction field.
_comment_disable_hurtboxes: Fresh larvae cannot be killed. Cosmologically: the Vagrant's second-death-grant works on substance that has already loosened (per the inward-imprint mechanism). Fresh larvae are still tightly arranged -- intact soul-form, no internal disruption. The Vagrant's swings pass through them. See [[project_soul_larvae_cosmology]] 'Fresh larvae are NOT killable'.
examine_text: A soul, freshly arrived. Its imprint is set; the queue ahead is jammed; it waits.
_comment_examine: Hell's third-person observation -- the larva is mute. Grimoire register, not the soul speaking. Spawn-side code registers an Examine-kind interactable when this field is non-empty.
_comment_spawn_clip: Fresh larvae spawn ALREADY in the crawl pose, not in the standing zombie_idle. Without this, the spawn pipeline binds idle_clip on frame 0 and the gait picker swaps to zombie_crawl on frame 1+; the actor renders as 'standing for a split second' before going prone. spawn_clip overrides the frame-0 bind. Per [[project_soul_larvae_cosmology]] -- the larva is never standing; it emerges already crawling.
_comment_idle: Idle clip plays once the fresh larva has arrived at its scripted target and is waiting for the on_arrival_delay to expire. zombie_idle is a standing-pose loop; cosmologically wrong for a not-yet-stood-up larva, but loopable + harmless. Polish-deferred: a low/prone idle authored against the crawl pose would be ideal here.
_comment_physical_reactions: Flinch + hit_react clips left at humanoid defaults. Moot for fresh larvae (no hurtboxes; no incoming hits) but preserved for the post-swap aged archetype semantics.
_comment_tint_color: Leached pale -- the fresh larva is a recently-arrived soul, imprint set but inward-burn hasn't yet darkened the substance. Slightly warm off-white reads better than pure white against the dark Limbo ambient.
_comment_tint_burn_target: While the fresh larva waits at the shore for the on_arrival_delay to expire, the render loop lerps its tint from this archetype's tint_color toward larva_aged's tint_color over the wait duration. Visualizes the inward-burn: the player watches the soul go from pale to sangue-red, and at the moment the lerp completes (t=1.0), the archetype swap fires + the larva stands up feral. Cosmologically the color IS the burn, made visible. Per [[project_soul_larvae_cosmology]].
